title: User Settings

appearance.title: Appearance & Typography
appearance.description: Customize message display mode, chat font scaling, and app zoom level.
appearance.previewMessage: Welcome to Tescord! This is a live preview showing typography and font scaling.
appearance.modeCozyDesc: Spacious layout with profile avatars and independent author header, great for casual chat.
appearance.modeCompactDesc: Denser inline layout without avatars, fitting maximum messages on screen.
appearance.zoomDesc: Proportionally scale the entire client interface. This preference is saved locally on this device.
appearance.shortcutHint: Shortcut Tip: Press Ctrl + / Ctrl - anytime to zoom in and out, Ctrl 0 to reset.

avatarSizePrompt: Recommended minimum size: 128x128 px. Supports WebP, PNG, or JPG.

audioVideo.vadDesc: No keys needed. Automatically broadcasts when you speak and mutes when silent.
audioVideo.pttDesc: Hold a key to speak and release to mute. Ideal for noisy environments.
audioVideo.vadSensitivityDesc: Speak naturally into your microphone. The bar turns green when audio passes the threshold.
audioVideo.rnnoiseDesc: Deep-learning based RNNoise filters out keyboard clatter, fan noise, and background chatter.
audioVideo.echoDesc: Prevents microphone feedback from catching speaker output.
audioVideo.gainDesc: Boosts quiet voices and protects against sudden loud volume spikes.
audioVideo.title: Voice & Video Settings (RNNoise AI Noise Control Center)
audioVideo.subtitle: Configure your input/output audio hardware, microphone sensitivity, neural noise suppression, and camera preview.
audioVideo.pttKeybindTip: Click the button to record, then press any key on your keyboard (supports Space, Ctrl, Caps Lock, etc.).
audioVideo.pttReleaseDelayDesc: The milliseconds your microphone remains active after releasing the key, preventing speech from being cut off abruptly.
audioVideo.noiseSuppressionSubtitle: Denoising runs on your device. Once you join a voice channel, the processed audio is still sent over the call. Only one model runs at a time.
audioVideo.rnnoiseDescDetailed: Lightweight 48 kHz real-time model. Browsers use WASM; Electron uses the same source as a native library.
audioVideo.rnnoiseSuitable: Ideal for daily gaming voice chat and meetings
audioVideo.dtlnDescDetailed: Two-stage 16 kHz LSTM model, resampled for 48 kHz calls.
audioVideo.dtlnSuitable: Try it with your own microphone and background noise
audioVideo.dfn3DescDetailed: 48 kHz complex deep filtering, with maximum attenuation limited to 12 dB by default.
audioVideo.dfn3Suitable: Compare it with the raw signal and other models
audioVideo.noiseOffDesc: Raw passthrough mode without software noise suppression, transmitting natural microphone sound directly.
audioVideo.noiseOffSuitable: Ideal for external soundcards with built-in hardware DSP
audioVideo.videoSectionDesc: Choose and preview your video capture devices locally to ensure optimal lighting and angle before calls.
audioVideo.videoPreviewPrompt: Click the button below to test your camera and verify framing and lighting.
audioVideo.cameraAccessError: Unable to access camera. Please check system permissions or device usage.
audioVideo.videoPreviewNotice: Preview runs locally only and will not broadcast video to your channel.
audioVideo.videoCodecsDesc: Set default video codec for camera and screen sharing. Hardware encoding capabilities are automatically detected.
audioVideo.dualCodecDesc: When streaming in AV1, H.264, or HEVC, a lightweight secondary VP8 stream is pushed concurrently. Viewers with older hardware seamlessly fallback to VP8 without black screens.
audioVideo.customBitrateDesc: Overrides default resolution preset bitrates. 1500–3000 kbps is recommended for AV1/HEVC, and 4000–6000 kbps for H.264 gaming streams.
audioVideo.codec_h264_desc: Widest hardware acceleration support, minimal CPU overhead and power usage, ideal for high FPS competitive gaming.
audioVideo.codec_av1_desc: Next-gen ultra-high compression, saves 40%+ bandwidth at identical quality, razor-sharp text and code rendering.
audioVideo.codec_av1_reason: AV1 encoding is currently not supported by this browser or GPU.
audioVideo.codec_vp9_desc: High quality with SVC scalable layering support, delicate details and resilient to unstable networks.
audioVideo.codec_vp9_reason: VP9 encoding is not supported in the current environment.
audioVideo.codec_vp8_desc: Broadest device compatibility, ideal for older low-spec hardware and cross-platform fallback.
audioVideo.codec_h265_desc: High compression ratio with mature hardware encoding, ideal for fast-moving gaming action.
audioVideo.codec_h265_reason: HEVC encoding is not supported in the current environment.
audioVideo.advancedAudioLabDesc: Includes Opus bitrate, echo cancellation, 48kHz high-fidelity stereo, and multi-track A/B/C noise comparison tests.
audioVideo.hiFiMusicDesc: Outputs raw stereo audio without AEC and noise suppression, ideal for musical instruments or live broadcasts.
audioVideo.echoCancellationDetail: Prevents speaker output from looping back into the microphone and creating harsh feedback.
audioVideo.agcDetail: Dynamically balances audio volume between whispers and loud shouts.
audioVideo.abLabTitle: AI Noise Suppression Multi-Track Comparison Lab
audioVideo.abLabDesc: Record one 5-second input, then replay it through RNNoise, DTLN and DeepFilterNet3. Detectable starts are aligned automatically; quiet or steady sounds may not align reliably. No SNR or speech-quality score is calculated.
audioVideo.abErrorMsg: Recording comparison test failed. Please check microphone permissions and device.
audioVideo.abRecordingPrompt: Type on keyboard, tap desk, or speak to test...

updates.webEnvironmentDesc: You are currently running in a standard web browser. Automatic updates and gh-proxy acceleration are only available in the Electron desktop app.
updates.webDesktopTip: Download and install the Tescord desktop app to enjoy Discord-style frameless windows, low-latency audio in an isolated process, and automatic background updates.
updates.updatesSubtitle: Tescord uses a Discord-like dual-track hot-update engine with instant seamless updates and stepped acceleration via gh-proxy to GitHub Releases.
updates.notConfigured: Not configured (not injected at build time)
updates.readyDesc: The delta package has been verified and extracted locally. Restart now to experience new features.
updates.fullInstallerNotice: This version includes native core changes. Please download the full installer from GitHub Releases.
updates.upToDate: You are running the latest version.
updates.proxyConfigDesc: In restricted network environments, the client automatically cascades through proxy routes: prioritizing high-speed mirrors and falling back smoothly.
updates.proxyPlaceholder: e.g. https://gh-proxy.net/ or leave empty for default stepped routing
updates.customProxyTip: If you host a private gh-proxy or mirror endpoint, specify it here to route traffic through your dedicated tunnel.

securityAndPasskeysDesc: Manage bound biometrics and hardware security keys. Sign in seamlessly with Touch ID, Windows Hello, or YubiKey.
passkeysSectionDesc: Bound credentials are securely stored inside your trusted device's hardware security module (Secure Enclave / TPM).
addPasskeyModalDesc: Enter a custom name for this device for easy identification and security auditing.
renamePasskeyDesc: Edit the display name for this passkey:
deletePasskeyDesc: Are you sure you want to remove this passkey? You will no longer be able to use it for biometrics sign-in. Please enter your account password to confirm:
noPasskeysHint: Click "Add Passkey" above to configure passwordless sign-in with your computer, phone, or hardware security key.
passkeyNotSupported: Passkeys are not supported in this environment
passkeyUnsupportedTitle: Passkeys not supported in this environment
passkeyUnsupportedNotice: WebAuthn hardware credentials are not available in the current runtime environment. To experience biometric passwordless sign-in, please open Tescord Web Client in a modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox).
